timing_verdict.text:
VERDICT: NEUTRAL timing to buy USD with KRW now

RATE: 1,429–1,430 KRW/USD

WHY: The won has recently strengthened significantly (July showed the highest appreciation rate since the financial crisis), pushing the rate down to around 1,430 won per dollar. However, multiple sources forecast the rate will stabilize in the 1,380–1,420 range going forward, suggesting the won may strengthen further, making dollars cheaper still in the near term.

TIP: Since forecasts suggest rates could improve (lower KRW needed per dollar), consider splitting your monthly $2,000 conversion across multiple dates rather than converting all at once, to capture potential further won-strengthening over coming weeks.
